title: Show live FIAT currencies in Add-Asset search using fx_rates.json cache

requirements.text: When the user selects the “Fiat” market type on AddAssetPage, load the FIAT currencies list from the backend-cached VPS1 endpoint (via the existing backend methods fetchFiatVPS1Data() + getFiatVPS1ValidationResult()) and render those currencies inside the existing Add‑Asset search results list (replacing the current static fiatCatalog list while data is available). Parse the JSON body returned from http://74.208.158.232/fx_rates.json and map each rates entry into an Asset object: marketType=fiat, ticker=countryCode (e.g., "ABW"), name=countryName (e.g., "Aruba, Kingdom of the Netherlands").

quotes: yes under Add‑Asset search list i want to see real list fetched from http://74.208.158.232/fx_rates.json

acceptanceCriteria: Selecting MarketType.fiat in AddAssetPage shows FIAT search results sourced from the VPS1 fx_rates.json response (not only the hardcoded frontend fiat list) when backend validationStatus is #valid.
FIAT assets are searchable by both ticker (countryCode) and name (countryName) using the existing search input in AssetSearch.
The mapping is correct: rates["ABW"].countryCode => Asset.ticker "ABW" and rates["ABW"].countryName => Asset.name "Aruba, Kingdom of the Netherlands".
If the backend has no cached FIAT result yet (null) or the cached result is invalid, the UI does not crash and provides a clear in-place empty/error message in the FIAT results area (in English).

requirements.text: Add a frontend data hook (or extend existing hooks) so that entering the Fiat market type automatically triggers a fetch/refresh of the VPS1 FIAT cache by calling fetchFiatVPS1Data(), then reads getFiatVPS1ValidationResult() and keeps the parsed FIAT Asset list in React Query cache for use by AssetSearch. Ensure loading and error states are handled in the Add‑Asset search UI without blocking other market types.

quotes: i don't see list of fiat currencies appears. what we should do to make it happen?

acceptanceCriteria: Switching to Fiat market type triggers a fetch (unless there is already a recent valid cached result and the implementation chooses not to refetch immediately).
While FIAT data is being fetched, the FIAT search area shows a loading indicator/message (English) instead of an empty list.
If the fetch fails, an error message is shown and the user can retry by re-selecting Fiat or via an explicit retry control implemented in the FIAT search area.
Switching to other market types (Crypto/Stocks/Commodities) continues to use the existing static catalog behavior and is unaffected by FIAT fetch failures.

constraints: Do not edit files under frontend/src/components/ui (Shadcn components are read-only).
Do not edit immutable frontend hook paths: frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.ts, frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.tsx, frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts, frontend/src/main.tsx.
Keep backend logic within the single Motoko actor at backend/main.mo; only add migration.mo if a stable-state change is required (this request should not require stable migration).
Preserve the exact endpoint URL for FIAT data: http://74.208.158.232/fx_rates.json.
nonGoals: Implementing base-currency conversion across the dashboard and holdings.
Adding crypto/stocks/commodities live catalogs or changing their ordering rules.
Changing access-control roles/permissions beyond what is required for FIAT list visibility in Add-Asset.
Building new UI pages beyond wiring the FIAT list into the existing Add-Asset search.
